name: Approve Custom Object Type
summary: Publishes a draft custom object type as the new approved version (the draft is deleted). This makes its fields usable.
whenToUse: After creating a type and adding its fields — approval is the final step before you can store records on it.
confirm: Publish the draft as the new approved version — the draft is deleted. The type must be in draft state and pass validation. Continue?
notes: You can only approve a type that is in draft state; already-approved types can't be re-approved.
